summary: The sky-map chatbot implementation faithfully realizes the design across both repos: the ported JD/LST math, inverse alt/az transform, closed-form rise solver and four-state classifier are correct and verified against the frontend; the 88 line-member constellation centers reproduce exactly from the frontend catalog with an idempotent seeder back-fill; SkyChatService (validation + alias/fuzzy resolution + FACTS prompt), GroqService.chatRaw, the /skymap/chat endpoint with generated DTOs, the two 400 handlers, the security permit rule, and the additive frontend chat panel threading lat/lon/time are all present. All 14 backend tests pass and both the backend package build and frontend build succeed; application.properties and mvnw are untouched by the task, no secret appears in the diff (the only secret change removes a pre-existing one), and nothing was pushed.

findings.detail: The frontend feature (FEAT-002) was committed locally as b15441f "feat: sky-map chat panel" on main, which deviates from the plan's "do not commit" instruction. It was not pushed (origin/main is unchanged), so it is reversible and non-blocking; the backend feature correctly remains uncommitted in the working tree.
